title: Review of lab1 membrane_evo (SIBDH): on fresh seeds 21-23 the up arm ends above its identical-event twin 3/3 and the down arm is purged 3/3, but late-window shares reverse on one seed
summary: Ran the three identical-event arms (membrane_evo_up b2=1.3b, membrane_evo twin b2=b, membrane_evo_down) unchanged on fresh seeds 21, 22, 23 (T=40000, as the lab-1 pack). Walled cells form from the noise start, divide (11 persistent splits, gen 3 on up s21; 9-13 on the down arm) and are cut by the imposed death disks (black disks on the sheets). Final K2 biomass share up vs twin: 0.93 vs 0.46, 0.78 vs 0.30, 0.82 vs 0.03; down arm 0.00 on all three (late mean <= 0.006) where the twin keeps 0.08-0.39. Mean over the last quarter of the run, up vs twin: 0.62 vs 0.28, 0.32 vs 0.39 (reversed), 0.70 vs 0.08; on seed 22 the up arm's K2 nearly vanished mid-run (0.77 -> 0.00) and returned by flips. On the sheets the high-yield K2 cells are visibly larger than K1 cells and than the twin's K2 cells.

observations.S: rerun/membrane_evo_up_s23/sheet.png t=0: noise over the whole domain (smoothed phi, random K, L); walled cells by t=1750
observations.B: rerun/membrane_evo_up_s21-23/FACTS.md: membrane (wall) channel rim/core 3.6-4.4, rim/outside 2.5-3.2, MEMBRANE-LIKE in 53-57 of ~70 individuals
observations.D: rerun/membrane_evo_up_s21/FACTS.md: 45 splits, 11 persistent, max generation 3, merge/split 0.24
observations.H: share.txt: final K2 share up > twin on 3/3 seeds (0.93/0.78/0.82 vs 0.46/0.30/0.03), down arm 0.00 on 3/3 vs twin 0.03-0.46; same event RNG per seed across arms

seeds_run.result: final pass (0.78 vs 0.30), late-quarter mean reversed (0.32 vs 0.39)

controls_run.H: rerun/membrane_evo_s21-23 (identical-event neutral twin) and rerun/membrane_evo_down_s21-23, same seeds

verdicts.limitation: Selection is real in direction (up rises, down is purged against the same events) but noisy: the K2 share swings by 0.5-0.8 within a run, and on seed 22 the time-averaged late share is lower than the twin's. Every death here is an imposed disk (sheets show the disks cutting cells), so this is not autonomous heredity, and I did not dissect how much of the sweep runs through disk fragments (the lab-1 caveat). share.py counts biomass and K2-majority components without merge-aware births. Lineage depth is gen 3 by labkit.
